method: Aggregate-only read of latest unambiguous retained Commusoft job versions, exact connection-scoped canonical job/property links and retained property source presence; no raw job, property or customer IDs returned
interpretation: The upstream property-review dependency dominates this cohort: 254 unlinked jobs reference an observed property source but lack a reviewed property link. A source row is not proof that its customer/site owner is ready or unchanged.
Twenty-five unlinked jobs reference property IDs whose property source has not been observed in the retained collection. Missing source cannot be guessed into an owner.
Three unlinked jobs have a reviewed customer-property link; they still need explicit job review before a canonical job card is claimed.
Most latest retained observations are over a day old. This is not a live Commusoft state check or proof of current completion.
